completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6181_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Butong in the Municipality of Cabuyao, Province of Laguna, is hereby converted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the Barrio of Butong.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
